task: Data-Driven De Novo Design of Super-Adhesive Hydrogels
objective: Statistically replicate protein sequence features to design synthetic hydrogels achieving robust underwater adhesion (>1 MPa)

methods.data_analysis: Exploratory analysis of 184 verified hydrogel formulations with 6 monomer composition features
methods.optimization: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) with Expected Improvement (EI) acquisition function

protein_inspiration.BA: Hydrophobic amino acids (Ala, Val, Leu, Ile, Pro, Met)
protein_inspiration.PEA: Aromatic amino acids (Phe, Tyr, Trp) - includes DOPA-like catechol chemistry
